items.q: Coleman Hawkins was -- had been hired from Jack Hilton to come to London to join his band.

ctx.x: Times were getting kind of hard with bands even then and really, I don't -- they weren't that hard

though. I don't really see why -- then Bennie Moten was scuffling because -- as big as he was namewise. That's when Basie took his band over, you see? Coleman Hawkins was -- had been hired from Jack Hilton to come to London to join his band. So, well, Fletcher's looking for some saxophone players to join his band. So in Kansas City, they had a cutting --play--- one night. I was in Little Rock. Ben, Herschel and Lester.
